verdict.rationale: Smooth publishes a structured API reference with per-endpoint pages (introduction, list tasks, cancel task, send event, sessions, custom tools, polling), and its quickstart includes copy-paste code. Nothing shows the reference is interactive, such as an in-browser 'try it' playground or runnable request console, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404 on all candidate paths. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable examples within the reference, a public OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.
